name: MATSUDA SANGYO Co., Ltd.
summary: MATSUDA SANGYO Co., Ltd. engages in the recovery and smelting of precious metals in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates in Precious Metals-Related Business and Food-Related Business segments. It also sells precious metal bullion, chemical products, and electronic materials; and collects, transports, and processes industrial waste, as well as sells and transports raw materials for food processing, such as marine, agricultural, and livestock products. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
